authorized_request: Evaluate current performance using the official competition metric

week_weighting: Equal weight per official WEEK_NUM, irrespective of row count
single_class_policy: Report undefined overall score and affected weeks; never delete a week or fill its AUC
partial_boundary_weeks: Keep every existing B/D record, including partial first/last weeks

checks: Per-week rank-U AUC and closed-form OLS recomputation
